results.description:
Play wild deuces game where you are given 5 cards to start with and you get to pick 1 card from discarded pile or remaining deck. Make 3 pairs to win the game. Game offers two variations: Wild Deuces & Without Wild Deuces. In Wild Deuces mode, the Deuce (2) of each suit acts as Wild card and can be paired with any card.

**** FEATURES ****
MULTI PLAYER
Play against online players in Quick match, public rooms or in private rooms. Invite your friends using codes to play with them.

SINGLE PLAYER
Play against smart AI Bots. AI improves as you level up in the game.

EVENTS
Game offers three kinds of Events and having unique events in each kinds. There are total of 10 unique Events going on in the game. Compete in them to get awesome rewards.

DAILY TASKS
Each day 4 tasks are given to the player which needs to be completed in single day. Each task offers different reward according to its difficulty. On completion of all tasks, A huge Jackpot is rewarded.

MAP
There are 5 map locations in the game and each map location offers 7 unique stages. All stages rewards a unique rare game item which can not be purchased anywhere. 

BUNDLES
Unlock different super most items from bundles which can not be obtained otherwise. These bundles are updated very frequently and items are superior to the legendary.

SCRATCH CARDS
Scratch different types of cards (Legendary, Golden & Silver) to get rare and legendary items.

DAILY BONUS
Get bonus each day you open the game.

LUCKY SPINNING WHEEL
Spin the wheel to test your luck to get rare and legendary items. Get a FREE spin each day.

PROFILE
Register your game account in game to create and save the profile. You can login with same account in multiple devices to resume your game.

LEAGUES & BADGES
A week long league is running in the game which awards the badges. Participate in the league and get minimum of 100 league points to get promoted to next rank league. Receive badges to showcase your skills.

LEADERBOARDS
Participate in Daily & Weekly leaderboards and compete against other players to get rewards according to your rank.

CHAT
Game offers live chatting with your friends. Invite your friends using codes and play with them or chat with them.

EMOTICONS
Use animated emotes in chatting while playing.

COLLECTIBLES
Collect different Avatars, Frames, Chat messages, Emoticons and Decks. All of them has different rarity. Common items are free and some are purchasable using game currency. The legendary items can only be obtained through Scratch cards. Some Special items are obtainable through Events and Some are obtainable through bundles only.

SUPPORT
You can contact the developers using Contact Panel from inside the game. Support is available 24/7.
